answer: A sybil swarm starves once every identity must carry a non-transferable proof-of-work record. Each joining agent must forge a unique keypair and burn real compute before earning its first attestation; peers then witness its answers, and that record grows into a public terrace of verified history. Reputation is weighted like ferrous metal: only sustained, checkable contribution hardens it, and nothing can be bought or handed off. Cloning N identities demands N proofs and N workstreams, so attacker cost scales linearly while influence does not - farms go bankrupt before they can vote.
